792-4279-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

306-3363.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
During your next upkeep, return The One Ring to your hand using Cache Raiders.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-2158-3249-4242.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-4242.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

654-1409-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
654-1409-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Gandalf by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Gandalf.
Resolve the Gandalf trigger, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

647-2034-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1580-2438-4871-4976.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-3249-5173-5334.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

1849-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1849-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1849-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3213-3417-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3213-3417-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible using Boromir.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3213-3417-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

4598-5195-7487.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Zealous Lorecaster
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-7452.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it

4613-4762-7347.description:
Activate Solarion by tapping it, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Solarion using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Solarion.
Repeat.
4613-4762-7347.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Solarion, you can instead use Devoted Druid's first ability to gain infinite {G}.

489-586-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-6289.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

104-3490-4476-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4476-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1387-1500-2871-6596-6898.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

1399-1606-4249-5396.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-4249-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1223-6797.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-6797.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities

4050-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-6701--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

252-5315-5394.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4377-6333-6334.manaNeeded: {U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4377-6333-6334.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Vanishing by paying {U}{U}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1641-1812-2034-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

890-1978-2410-2652.notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Alloy Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1978-2410-2652.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

1849-2906-3100-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.You have at least two opponents.
Opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn plus an additional 2 life for each time you've cast Codie from the command zone this game, minus 1 life for each opponent you have beyond the second.
1849-2906-3100-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Lampad of Death's Vigil by paying {1} and sacrificing Codie.
Choose to return Codie to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Lampad of Death's Vigil trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Codie from the command zone by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.
NOTE: This combo ends once you have one opponent remaining, as the lifeloss from Lampad of Death's Vigil no longer covers Codie's increased commander tax.
However, you may be able to get more iterations if you started the combo with three or more opponents, as Rakdos will decrease Codie's cost by {3}, outpacing the {2} from commander tax, until you have two or less opponents.
 Once you have a large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 11 for each remaining trigger.

624-1300-1322-3065-3172.notablePrerequisites: You control Forests and/or green creatures that can tap to add {2}{U}{G}{G}.
624-1300-1322-3065-3172.description:
Tap Forests and/or green creatures to add at least {2}{U}{G}{G}.
Pay {2}{G} and discard Colossal Skyturtle to activate its first activated ability, targeting Phantasmal Image.
In response, pay {G} and tap Weaver of Harmony to activate it, copying Colossal Skyturtle's ability and choosing Colossal Skyturtle as the target.
Resolve all abilities, returning Phantasmal Image and Colossal Skyturtle to your hand.
Tap Patron of the Orochi to activate it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Pay {1}{U} to cast and resolve Phantasmal Image, having it enter as a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put the original Patron of the Orochi into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Tap Forests and/or green creatures to add at least {3}{G}{G}.
Pay {2}{G} and discard Colossal Skyturtle to activate its first activated ability, targeting Patron of the Orochi.
Pay {G} and tap Weaver of Harmony to activate it, copying Colossal Skyturtle's ability and choosing Colossal Skyturtle as the target.
Resolve all abilities, returning Patron of the Orochi and Colossal Skyturtle to your hand.
Tap Phantasmal Image to activate it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Sacrifice Phantasmal Image and pay {0} to cast Patron of the Orochi for its snake offering cost.
Repeat.
